digest.component_or_area: BindingStore identity transitions and BindingLifecycle extraction
propositions: BindingLifecycle must extract cohesive identity transition rules (bind, confirm, unbind, reverse cleanup, numeric-ID re-key) from BindingStore while preserving all existing behaviors exactly
bind_confirm must remain last-writer-wins on forward entry and pop exactly one differing old reverse key with no sweep, detection, or abort
Stale reverse entries must be removed only in four permitted cases: rebind, unbind with sweep, re-key, and retire—not in any other circumstance
Numeric-ID re-key must move issues by updating both indexes and resetting absence count, not retire them

note_absent_or_rekey must delegate only the re-key mutation (steps 3-4 comparison and key swap) to BindingLifecycle while keeping the coordinator guard and no-client/no-id fall-through on the facade with no outcome change
